text:
Ash Patel: Quick ask  we need a compact benchmark microframe for the launch assets by EOD. Audience: infra leads + PMs. Keep 2 visuals max.
Carmen Li: Proposal: Visual A = latency distribution (P50/P95/P99) vs unit cost ($/1k tokens). Visual B = routing decision diagram (fastpath vs econpath). Headline + 2 bullets each.
Doug R: For Visual A use x=latency (ms), y=cost ($/1k). Plot two clusters: quantized high-throughput vs unquantized high-accuracy. Mark SLA bands (gold/silver/bronze).
Tara (prod): Headline idea: "Latency where it counts, price where it doesn't." Short CTA for webinar signup under the charts.
Ash Patel: Routing thresholds: if end-to-end <150ms -> route to low-latency model; otherwise -> cost-optimized. Add note: can override per-customer SLA.
Carmen Li: Draft chart headlines: (A) "Latency vs Unit Cost: pick your tradeoff" (B) "Auto-routing: keep UX snappy, costs low" Bullets: "P95 maps to perceived slowness" and "Smart routing reduces token spend 30260% (example)"
Doug R: Data plan: run microbench for chat-short (seq=64) and long-context (seq=1024). Callout: quantized pipeline ~2.5x cheaper on long contexts. I'll supply P50/P95/P99 points.
Tara (prod): Webinar hook: 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Title candidate: "Serving LLMs: tune for latency and dollars" Promo copy: 1-line hook + 3 quick benefits -> I can draft landing content after visuals.
Ash Patel: Ops asks: @Carmen produce two PNGs + alt text; @Doug paste 3 datapoints per slice; include a token->$ example (1M tokens ~= $X) as a small annotation and mark as "example".
BenchBot: queued microbench job id=89277. Will upload CSV to internal when complete. :robot_face:
Carmen Li: I'll do PNG variants: 1) cluster comparison 2) split-by-workload rows. Keep chart titles <= 12 words. Need numbers by 3pm.
Doug R: Running now. Will post CSV link here once BenchBot finishes.
BenchBot: job 89277 finished  results: https://internal/bench/89277.csv
Ash Patel: Great. Carmen, use conservative pricing for token example and clearly label as sample. Also create alt text describing the two clusters and routing flow for accessibility.
Carmen Li: Noted. Design Q: include small legend explaining quantization and throughput assumptions? Helps technical reviewers.
Tara (prod): Yes include a 1-line legend: "quantized=low precision kernel, better throughput; unquantized=higher quality".
Doug R: P50/P95/P99 datapoints uploaded in CSV. Quick summary: chat-short (P95~110ms, cost $0.12/1k), long-context quantized (P95~320ms, cost $0.05/1k), long-context unquantized (P95~780ms, cost $0.13/1k).
Ash Patel: Final checklist restated: 2 PNGs, alt text, chart copy (headlines+2 bullets), 3 datapoints CSV, token cost example, webinar CTA copy. Target EOD. Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
Carmen Li: On it; will drop PNGs + alt text here when ready.
Tara (prod): Landing copy draft incoming by 5pm.
Doug R: Done with numbers; happy to review visuals for accuracy.
Ash Patel: Thanks everyone. We'll do a quick morning pass tomorrow if anything needs tightening.
